newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices rise on overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices rise on overseas demand.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices rose on overseas demand at the weekely auction on Tuesday, brokers said.

Brokers said buyers for Pakistan, Poland, Russia, Jordan and Sudan operated actively and lifted mostly large and bold brokens types. Local buyers and blenders bought mainly small brokens and fannings grades, pushing almost all grades of teas up.
Some 987,070 kgs of teas were sold. Average price was 46.77 taka per kg, 0.94 taka up from the previous sale. The next auction will be held on December 17 with an expected offer of 1.28 million kg.
